When to post

WhenWhat
CountdownPhoto countdown, post and story: “one week” on Tue Nov 3, “5 days” on Thu Nov 5, “this Tuesday” on Sun Nov 8, “tomorrow” on Mon Nov 9, “today” on Tue Nov 10. Skip any that have passed.
Countdown (optional)Countdown stories (8 days → 1), one a day: start from the one that matches how many days are left until registration opens (its file name says which, e.g. 5 days to go), and skip any that have passed. The 3-days-to-go story falls on Shabbat, so skip it or post after Shabbat.
Tue Nov 10Registration is open countdown post and story (“OPEN”), with the pieces below.
Before Nov 10Am I eligible? carousel and story, so students are ready on day one.
Tue Nov 10Registration is open story and post, the launch reel, your WhatsApp status, and the campus flier: post it, print it, hang it up.
Nov 10 onHow to register carousel and story.
Weeks afterContact card, and repost the flier and the eligibility check.
  • Instagram carousels: pick the slides in order (1 of 4, 2 of 4…) in one post.
  • Stories, the reel and WhatsApp status are 1080×1920; posts are 1080×1350 (4:5). The reel is a 14-second MP4 with no music, so you can add a sound in Instagram.
  • Print: the Letter flier comes as a PDF (8.5×11 in) and a high-res PNG.
  • On a phone: “Save / share” sends graphics straight to your photos or to WhatsApp.
